snippet.title: MolEconomy: Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672270/MolEconomy

Welcome to the underground world of MolEconomy – a charming, strategic simulation where industrious moles dig deep to build a thriving subterranean society. Start with a pickaxe and a patch of dirt, and evolve into a sprawling economy powered by resource extraction, useful production chains, and clever market moves.

Mine valuable resources, refine them into powerful alloys, and craft unique products to trade on the ever-shifting market. Expand your mole colony with vital infrastructure – from school to train the next generation of genius diggers, to cutting-edge research center that unlocks powerful upgrades and new technologies.

Whether you're optimizing supply lines or watching your mole citizens grow smarter and more efficient, every tunnel leads to new possibilities.

Key Features:
🛠️ Deep Resource Management – Extract ores, refine materials, and build intricate production systems.
📈 Dynamic Market System – Prices fluctuate based on supply and demand. Outsmart the market to maximize profits!
🏗️ Build & Expand – Construct essential buildings like schools, housing, research labs, and more to scale your economy.
🧠 Research & Progression – Unlock new technologies to enhance efficiency, discover new products, and automate your operations.
🐾 Mole Society Simulation – Your moles needs you to guide them. Build a balanced, efficient community.

Can you turn a humble colony into a mole-tropolis of industry and innovation?

Coming to Steam before the end of May 2025
